title: Only what changed
description:
Sync records since the last run, using a high-water mark.

```
run 1: synced 3 (up to 2026-11-20T10:00)
run 2: synced 0
new record added
run 3: synced 1 (up to 2026-11-20T11:15)
```
hints: ISO times as text sort correctly, so `r["updated"] >= state["mark"]` works without parsing (lesson 5.03).
After a run, the new mark is the largest `updated`, and `ids_at_mark` the ids with exactly that time.
requirements: Records have an `updated` time; each run fetches only those newer than the saved mark.
Save the mark only after the whole batch succeeded.
Records with the same time as the mark must not be lost: compare with `>=` and skip ids already synced at that time.
stretch: Store the state in a JSON file so it survives between runs.
